name: Shop row with flats (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Two-storey row of three small shops, 24 x 12 m: dark panel shopfronts with glazed doors under fabric awnings (red, blue, green) and blank fascia signs in matching colours, brick flats above. Each unit: a shop at the front and a store room behind it; a rear door to a lobby and a stair up to a flat with a sitting room across the front, a bedroom and a bathroom off a short hall.
